description: help.v1.json stores `prose` as the program placeholder. A build that names another program (a developer build invoked as prose-dev) prints that name in every command of a help topic: a line starting with `prose `, the `Usage: prose` line and every `prose ...` code span. Other words are unchanged. Both ports apply this rule (Rust `render::localize_help_for`, Bun `localizeHelpFor`).

Examples:
